points: Q3 non-GAAP subscription and fintech gross profit is guided to $615–625 million, up 22–24% year over year; hitting the high end would confirm the raised full-year outlook is on track.
Net new locations in Q3 will show whether the record 9,500 adds in Q2 was a one-time surge or a sustained go-to-market pace, which matters for future GPV and recurring profit growth.
ARR growth of 25% in Q2 to $2.4 billion sets the bar for Q3; holding strong recurring revenue growth supports operating leverage and the long thesis.

Operating income and Adjusted EBITDA margins after the $10 million tariff refund reinvestment will reveal whether Toast can keep investing while staying profitable, backing the 14-to-0 upward EPS revision trend.

Full-year 2026 non-GAAP subscription and fintech gross profit guidance was raised to $2,325–2,355 million, or 23–25% growth; Q3 results will test whether that sets up a favorable Q4 and a path toward FY2 EPS of $1.73.
GPV grew 22% year over year to $60.7 billion in Q2; Q3 volume growth will show if payment activity keeps pace with new locations, supporting the PEG case despite the P/E premium.
watch: Q3 non-GAAP subscription and fintech gross profit growth at or above the 22–24% guide — supports the long
Net new locations added in Q3 matching or exceeding the Q2 pace of 9,500 — supports the long
ARR growth holding near the Q2 25% year-over-year rate — supports the long
FY2026 non-GAAP subscription and fintech gross profit guidance maintained or raised — supports the long
